create_kinetics_dataset: create a small Kinetics-like dataset with video files and CSV annotations in a directory
create_dummy_video_frames: create dummy video frames as a PyTorch tensor with Gaussian blobs moving across frames
write_csv_file: write a list of rows to a CSV file with space-delimited columns
use_tempdir_decorator: use the tempdir decorator to auto-create and clean up a temporary directory for test methods
mock_trainer_params: mock PyTorch Lightning trainer init params to disable logging and checkpointing for unit tests
